summary: The blinding output scanner passed an output that printed a sealed value as an integer with rounding zeros (22000 or 22010 for a sealed 22014).

observables: blinding scan verdict of outputs, logs and caches (core.blinding scan_text and scan_paths, skills/hep-computing/scripts/audit_blinded_outputs.py)
impact.bias: a false pass: a sealed number printed as an integer rounded to tens or coarser (3 or more significant digits) was not reported; no analysis number changes
impact.trigger: a sealed value written in an output as an integer whose trailing zeros are rounding (22000, 22,000, 22010 for 22014)

outputs.how_to_recognize: the blinding audit's JSON report (stdout, or --report FILE) and scan verdicts; the scanner writes no artifact, and a measurement-spec does not record that it ran

remedy: rescan the outputs of the blinded analysis with a release that has the fix (audit_blinded_outputs.py); a new hit means a blinded value was exposed and goes to the custodian
